scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d --wait prisma-postgres redis-cache elasticsearch
scripts.dev: npm run build:schemas && npm run dev:infra && concurrently --kill-others -n api-java,scraper,angular-app -c green,magenta,blue "npm run dev:api-java" "npm run dev:scraper" "npm run dev:angular-app"
scripts.test: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api-java,scraper,angular-app -c green,magenta,blue "npm run test:api-java" "npm run test:scraper" "npm run test:angular-app"
scripts.test:coverage: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api-java,scraper,angular-app -c green,magenta,blue "npm run test:coverage:api-java" "npm run test:coverage:scraper" "npm run test:coverage:angular-app"
